scope: Historical candidate21 paired interpolation diagnostic, same actual source, native model, contact controller and initial state.60Hz recorded linear/secant versus five source phase-stop C2 waypoints. Current engine source has since changed. Prefixes are development evidence, not full movement/clinical/contact acceptance.

initialization.scope: Retargeted source setup initializes native state once. A signed vertical rigid-envelope fit places the lowest native contact surface 1 mm above the floor; source world goals remain unchanged and their initial mismatch is measured. Gravity, native contact and bounded motor torques determine all later motion.

passiveContact.reason: Initial self-contact is within the native residual gate
